commands.name: list_environments
commands.description: List environment names and IDs and the current environment.

commands.name: travel
commands.description: Shift the player to the exact environment ID discovered through list_environments.

commands.name: create_environment
commands.description: Create a named environment from an installed zone package. Omit template to use The Grid.

commands.name: follow
commands.description: Have the companion float alongside the player and travel with them.

commands.name: stay
commands.description: Park the companion at its current location.

commands.name: search_assets
commands.description: Search downloadable Sketchfab and Poly Haven models and return provenance and licenses.

commands.name: import_asset
commands.description: Prepare an exact asset ID from search_assets. Check asset_status before spawning.

commands.name: asset_status
commands.description: Check preparation status for an exact asset ID.

commands.name: list_assets
commands.description: List prepared models with author, source and license credits.

commands.name: spawn_entity
commands.description: Place a prepared model in the active scene. A scale of 1 gives a one-metre longest edge.

commands.name: spawn_asset
commands.description: Find, prepare and place an external model from a short search phrase or asset ID.

commands.name: inspect_animation
commands.description: List animation targets or inspect supported channels, joints and the current clip.

commands.name: preview_animation
commands.description: Apply or revise a temporary looping clip on an inspected target. activity:<kind> targets take joint tracks only and play on the companion while previewing.

commands.name: save_animation
commands.description: Save the active animation preview. A saved prop animation supports scene undo.

commands.name: discard_animation
commands.description: Restore the previous motion from before the preview.

commands.name: list_workshop_tools
commands.description: Discover actions registered in the current Grid space, including previewed actions.

commands.name: run_workshop_tool
commands.description: Run an explicitly requested action from the current workshop catalog.

commands.name: unsupported
commands.description: Use when no registered command can fulfill the request.

commands.name: inspect_scene
commands.description: Look inside the running world: a node's type, its children and the values of its editable properties. Start with no path for the world itself.

commands.name: tweak_property
commands.description: Set any property of any node in the running world now, such as a light's energy or a material's color. Tweaks last this session; keep_tweaks saves them into the project.

commands.name: keep_tweaks
commands.description: Save this session's tweaks into the project as a Workbench draft of world/data/tweaks.json. They apply whenever the world or an environment loads.

commands.name: discard_tweaks
commands.description: Put every property tweaked this session back as it was.

commands.name: save_environment
commands.description: Save this environment's in-world edits (its pieces, placed props and terrain, and its atmosphere) into the project as a Workbench draft of its package. Commit the draft to make them part of Euclid for everyone.

commands.name: refresh_asset
commands.description: Load a model or material again from its files on disk, everywhere it is used: its caches are cleared and the environment rebuilds if it uses it. Give asset_id for a model or material for a material. Use it after an asset's files were replaced.

commands.name: capture_view
commands.description: See the 3D world: through the player's current view (from player), from a point you choose aimed at a point or node (from point), or from a camera you placed (from camera). Returns an image of the world only; interface and private surfaces never appear. The player's Agent vision setting may limit this to placed cameras or turn it off.

commands.name: place_camera
commands.description: Place a named camera at a position, aimed at a point or node, to look through later with capture_view from camera. Placing a name again moves it.

commands.name: pointed_at
commands.description: What the player last pointed at with T: its node path (for inspect_scene and tweak_property), its piece and asset or material, the point hit and where the player stood. Messages sent right after pointing carry it too.

commands.name: undo_agent
commands.description: Undo what one agent did: unload every change it has live, and, if its commit is the latest one, offer the player a one-key revert.
